parameters.name: Backend
parameters.description: The IP address of the origin server or the back-to-origin domain name. You can specify only one of these options.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain name added to WAF.

parameters.name: DomainId
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to view the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the resource. A maximum of 20 tags are supported.
